title: fix: recheck unfinished plans before an agent stops
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: an agent can end its reply while its newly saved plan still lists unfinished, authorized work, leaving the session idle.

## User Impact

The built-in agent gets one chance to reconsider that stop: continue feasible work, reconcile the plan, or explain a concrete blocker. This can add one model response; it is not a guarantee of task completion. Old cards never restart idle work, and other agent harnesses are unchanged. No stored-data shape or production migration changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Observe successful canonical plan saves at the existing pre-terminal boundary. Continue the same logical prompt with its transcript, completed effects, permissions, and deadline—not a replay or rewind. The check is bounded across retries. Cancellation, steering, approval/child/media handoffs, status-only refreshes, and explicit plugin finalization retain priority. Already-shown checkpoints remain in the conversation.

CI prerequisite repairs landed in main while this PR was being verified: [database routing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160349), [Doctor mocks](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/162dea17b031), [PID-only readiness](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ee15d2ba1da5), and the [requester-wake clock repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160407). The branch uses those owners unchanged. Our duplicate timer helper and its tests were removed; the original requester-wake assertions remain in main. This PR now contains only the agent completion check, its focused tests, and documentation.

## Evidence

- The incident-shaped regression failed before the runtime repair. Its **20 completion cases** cover registered direct and nested tool calls, same-prompt continuation, and executing the first mutation exactly once.
- **27 terminal-delivery tests** and **24 media-payload tests** pass. The non-streamed session case retains attachment URL, metadata, trust, and voice state across the follow-up; final merging includes the attachment URL once. No runtime media-delivery change was needed.
- The **23 retained feature files** remain byte-identical to the reviewed and locally tested implementation after upstream fixture integration. Prior focused proof is retained for unchanged inputs.
- **Test-audit:** meaningful registered session/tool boundaries remain covered; no sleeps, larger timeouts, weakened expectations, or per-case Gateway boots were added. Retiring the duplicate clock helper retires its helper-only tests, not the original runtime coverage.
- **Deslop:** reuse the existing terminal owner and same-prompt follow-up mechanism; no durable task queue, replay manager, new configuration, or production timeout was introduced. Superseded fixture repairs are not duplicated.
- **AutoReview:** P0–P2 feature and incremental reviews are scoped-clean. The final reconciliation removes superseded test-only changes; the retained feature implementation is unchanged.
- Formatting, targeted lint, affected type graphs, line-cap/max-lines ratchets, and assertion-safety checks passed for the relevant changes. Main’s smaller requester retry repair has independently verified exact-head green CI and all 18 cases passing.

These are deterministic provider/Gateway stand-ins with real session and worker boundaries—not live-provider, Telegram, or deployed-Gateway proof. Separate local cold-start and inventory followups [#160383](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160383) and [#160322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160322) are not claimed fixed here; earlier failed attempts are not counted as passes.

Integrated `main` once in merge commit `565329e3000f0c0b78b729f6638c781a743c1e68` for the named failing gates. The `checks-node-changed-3` sandbox-image failure was inherited CI infrastructure: [#160489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160489) added the missing image setup. Main also supplies the one-category manifest fix `09bea762930` and reply-turn-admission recovery fix `9fe93a20`. The PR feature and its tests were not edited during this merge. Post-merge focused tests passed 223/223 across six files, including both Doctor E2E cases. [Exact-head CI run 36446650573](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36446650573) ended cancelled after [checks-ui-e2e (3/9)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36446650573/job/109011279995) timed out waiting for the Stop button to detach in an unchanged mock-Gateway Control UI test (366 other tests in that shard passed). The PR diff changes no `ui/`, `src/gateway/`, or `src/auto-reply/` files; this UI fixture uses Vite and a mock Gateway, so the failure is outside the changed agent completion path. No same-shard local replay was run; existing UI defect versus timing flake remains unproven. `checks-node-changed-3` and `checks-node-changed-compact-large-8` passed; `compact-large-24` was not selected. ClawSweeper reviewed this exact head, found no actionable defect, and marked it ready for maintainer review. No PR merge or deployment was performed.

<details>
<summary>Measured test cost</summary>

Each retained local measurement used `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1`. Cold compilation can dominate wall time. Per-file CI seconds will be added when available from the new completed run.

| Test file | Cases passed | Local wall | CI seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-plan-completion.test.ts` | 20 | 59.02 s | Pending |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.before-terminal-delivery.test.ts` | 27 | 12.10 s | Pending |
| `src/agents/tools/progress-card-tool.test.ts` | 9 | 11.93 s | Pending |
| `src/plugin-sdk/agent-harness-private-options.test.ts` | 3 | 41.87 s | Pending |
| `src/agents/harness/selection.test.ts` | 162 | 62.72 s | Pending |

The unchanged media-payload suite passed 24 tests in 12.04 seconds. Four stream/session/lifecycle sibling suites passed 125 tests in a combined 25.89-second invocation. The original feature’s full changed checks passed; later affected type/lint/format proof is retained separately from the noted local inventory-limit failure.

</details>

<details>
<summary>CI prerequisite history and preserved investigation evidence</summary>

- The [first run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36398698700) hit shared-compiler scheduling; the requested main rebase incorporated [#160290](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160290).
- Subsequent runs exposed [PID readiness](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160313), [database routing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160354), and [Doctor mock exports](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160355). Main now supplies those repairs as linked above.
- A duplicate routing entry appeared only in GitHub’s combined tree after the same repair landed upstream. Reconciliation retained the upstream entry; no duplicate guard or row cap was changed.
- [Run 36413298855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36413298855/job/108899274261) exposed the [requester-wake clock race](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160406): 105 jobs passed, one runtime job failed, 13 were cancelled, and the aggregate gate failed. That cancelled run is not passing CI evidence.
- Independent Blacksmith Testbox reproduction ran the original 18-case file in its original order: 1 failed / 17 passed before, then 18/18 passed with our synchronized-clock candidate. The three helper regressions also passed. Provider lease `tbx_01m3kw5jqkmnkypjetngh4bnzj` is stopped; [backing run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36415513590). Before/after wrapper walls were 777.80 / 700.54 seconds including runtime preparation; after-fix Vitest time was 48.17 seconds. This candidate is now superseded, not shipped alongside main’s fix.
- Main’s adopted implementation uses the recorded retry deadline and existing root-work join, retaining the full 151-second window and all original assertions without a new general helper. Its exact head `387cea3bea22575c800393f591ebaec8964a61e6` has [successful CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36418727017); [the inspected runtime job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36418727017/job/108916422502) passes all 18 cases, including the previously failing row. That is upstream prerequisite proof, not this PR’s current-head CI.

</details>
